name: lipgloss-render-loss-diagnostics-across-6a96
instr:
Lipgloss cannot currently report content that was wrapped, shortened, hidden, filtered, clipped, or skipped. Add structured diagnostics to the exact output invocation without changing rendering, layout, ANSI, whitespace, or writer behavior.

`charm.land/lipgloss/v2` exports `LossReason`, `Loss`, `RenderReport`, `CanvasReport`, `LayerLocation`, `PlaceReport`, `StyleRangesReport`, `FprintReport`, and `SprintReport`. Reasons are `LossWidth = iota`, `LossHeight`, `LossWrapped`, `LossHidden`, `LossFiltered`, `LossClipped`, and `LossSkipped`. `Loss` has `Reason LossReason; SourceStart int; SourceEnd int; OutputStart int; OutputEnd int; Location any`. `RenderReport` has `Output string; Losses []Loss`. `CanvasReport` has `RenderReport RenderReport; Clipped []image.Rectangle`; `LayerLocation` has `ID string; Bounds image.Rectangle`.

Preserve fragment order, deterministic loss order, ANSI-safe terminal-cell ranges, nested-report offsets, and overlapping partial-style range identity and order. Distinguish wrapping, width loss, height loss, and clipping in style and placement.

Tables preserve row and column identity through allocation, offsets, filtering, and nested style losses. `charm.land/lipgloss/v2/table` exports `TableLocation` with `Row int; Column int; Header bool`, plus `New`. Trees and lists retain traversal identities and nested reasons. Their packages export `TreeLocation` and `ListLocation`, each with `Path []int`.
